scope: new owner-received Chinese news versions after the actual research-worker start; observed cache coverage must be audited before a no-news value is defined

signal_snapshot.calendar: verified US equity regular-session calendar, including half days as sessions
signal_snapshot.eligible_inputs: version received and score completed no later than snapshot; candidate signal availability is max(received_at_utc,scored_at_utc)

features.N1: equal-weight mean text tone of explicitly company-linked algorithmic event groups available by snapshot
features.N2: number of distinct available algorithmic event groups with explicit company linkage
features.duplicates: same article revision contributes once; suspected reprints grouped as an algorithmic proxy, not independent confirmation
features.ambiguous_company_and_macro: retain text score without assigning a company direction
features.price_recap: flag and separately exclude from a prespecified sensitivity view; never use price recap as evidence that news caused a move

target.primary: next eligible regular session open to that session close, adjusted for verified corporate actions
target.secondary: next eligible regular session open to fifth eligible session close, adjusted for verified corporate actions
target.entry: licensed next-regular-session open price with verified source timestamp; exclude when unavailable, never substitute a quote point or minute bar
target.price_data_gate: source, timestamps, trading calendar, split/dividend adjustment and gap coverage verified before scoring
target.cost: not set in this no-return run; freeze a separate cost scenario before any later return evaluation; no execution or profit claim

paired_models.sample_rule: same eligible company-snapshot rows, labels and chronological folds for all four groups; training-only transforms and hyperparameters; purge labels crossing fold boundaries
paired_models.source_coverage_gate: complete licensed news and matching price coverage required for the paired test

boundaries: Chinese text tone is not a stock return probability or verified news fact
cache-replay scores cannot be relabeled as prospective
April-July 2026 viewed labels remain outside this run
no return model, IC, backtest, or trading in v4.1
